y-m-24-01.title: Kana yashanda pa x=0 ne x=1, inoshanda pa x yese here?
y-m-24-01.topic: Kuverenga nemavara: ma product ema powers eletter imwechete, nema counterexamples
y-m-24-01.goal: Tonga kana kutarisa kuti expression inoshanda pa nhamba shoma ihumbowo hwekuti inoshanda pa nhamba dzese, uye ugadzire counterexample iwe pachako uye utsanangure kuti nhamba dzipi dzinoita kuti mativi maviri aenzane nenjodzi chete.
y-m-24-01.material: Sua akati, "x²×x³ i x⁶!" (Kuverenga: x squared times x cubed i x to the sixth.) Sua akaisa 0 pa x uye mativi ese akava 0, uye akaisa 1 pa x uye mativi ese akava 1. Mubasa iri, x i nhamba kubva ku -5 kusvika ku 5, uye unogonawo kuisa ma decimals.
y-m-24-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva powers (muenzaniso: x³ i x yakawanzwa ka3)
y-m-24-01.prereq.1: Kuwana mutengo we expression nekuisa nhamba dzakashomeka nema decimals paletter
y-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinogona kutaurwa kubva pakutarisa kwaSua (mativi ese akafanana pa x=0 ne x=1)?
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kuti nhamba mbiri dzakaiswa naSua, 0 ne 1, dzinosiyana sei nenhamba dzimwe.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchida kuedza chirevo chaSua, nyora nhamba mbiri kana tatu dzaungaisa pa x.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.a: Mativi ese akafanana pa x=0 ne x=1, saka tinogona kupedzisa kuti inoshanda pa x yese
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandura kubudirira kuviri kuita 'inoshanda pa nhamba dzese'. Kunyange kana mienzaniso mishoma ichishanda, hazvireve 'dzese'.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.b: Mativi ese akafanana pa x=0 ne x=1, asi hatisati taziva kana akafanana pa x dzimwe
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.b: Uku i kufunga kwekutonga pasina kupfuura range inovharwa nemienzaniso yakatarisirwa. Kuti x ipi inoiswa inotevera kunova kwakakosha.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.c: Mativi ese akafanana pa x=0 ne x=1, saka tinogona kupedzisa kuti inogara ichishanda kana x i positive
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakadzikisira 'dzese' kuita 'positive', asi wakatarisa nhamba imwe chete ye positive, 1. Kudzikisa range hakuwedzeri humbowo.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.d: Mativi ese akafanana pa x=0 ne x=1, saka humbowo hwabuda hwekuti chirevo chaSua chakaipa
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakaverenga mhedzisiro imwechete sehumbowo hwerutivi rwakapesana. Kutarisa uku hakusi humbowo hwekuti chakaipa zvakare.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Chokwadi chekuti mitengo miviri yakafanana chakasimbiswa pamitengo iyoyo miviri chete. Kuti utsvage muenzaniso unoputsa chirevo, unofanira kuedza x isiri 0 ne 1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise mitengo 3 yakasiyana ye x apo x²×x³ ne x⁶ vane mitengo yakasiyana. (x i kubva ku -5 kusvika ku 5)
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa 2 pa x uye uverenge x²×x³ ne x⁶ zvakaparadzana.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ukasangana nenhamba inopa mutengo wakafanana, chinjira kune imwe nhamba uverenge. Unogona kuedzawo ma negative numbers nema decimals.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.ok.c1: x i kubva ku -5 kusvika ku 5.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita x nhamba kubva ku -5 kusvika ku 5.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Mitengo ye x²×x³ ne x⁶ yakasiyana. I muenzaniso unoputsa chirevo chaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune x iyi, mativi maviri akafanana. Hausi muenzaniso unoputsa chirevo chaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana x=2, x²×x³=4×8=32 uye x⁶=64, dzakasiyana. Kana x=-1, i -1 ne 1, uye kana x=0.5, i 0.03125 ne 0.015625, dzakasiyana. x dzega dzinoita kuti mativi maviri afanane i 0 ne 1, saka Sua akangosarudza nhamba mbiri chaidzo dzinoita kuti dzifanane.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Udza Sua. Nyora kuti sei dzakangoitika dzakafanana pa x=0 ne x=1, dzakatariswa naSua, uye kuti sei dzichisiyana pa nhamba dzimwe.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Unogona kutora x yawakawana pamusoro uye mhedzisiro yekuverenga kwayo uye kuishandisa sezvazviri.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora kwauri pachako kuti zvinoitika kumutengo kana ukatora powers dze 0 ne 1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: kunyange kana ukatora powers dze 0 kana 1, ... saka ...
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora nemashoko ako kuti sei kuisa 0 kana 1 chete hakuputsi chirevo here?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakapa x imwe chete kana kupfuura inoputsa chirevo, nenhamba here?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.0: 0 ne 1 zvinoramba zviri 0 ne 1 pasinei nekuti zvinowanzwa kangani, saka mativi ese akangoitika akafanana. Kana ukaisa 2, x²×x³ i 32 asi x⁶ i 64, saka dzakasiyana. Saka kuwana mbiri dzakarurama hakureve kuti inogara iri yakarurama.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Dzakafanana pa x=0 ne x=1 chete, uye dzakasiyana pa nhamba dzimwe. Kana x i 2, 4×8=32 uye 2⁶=64, saka hadzina kufanana. x²×x³ i x yakawanzwa ka5 uye x⁶ i x yakawanzwa ka6, saka huwandu hwekuwanza hwakasiyana.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Nzira yekutsanangura nehuwandu hwekuwanza x yakanakawo.

y-m-24-02.title: Zvirongwa zvekurenda mabhasikoro: chipi chakachipa kana ukatasva nguva refu?
y-m-24-02.topic: Kushandisa linear functions: kuenzanisa ma expression maviri emitengo
y-m-24-02.goal: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako nenhevedzano apo data inowedzera, uye unyore notice ine mamiriro zvichibva panguva apo mitengo yema linear expressions maviri inova yakaenzana.
y-m-24-02.material: Public bicycle rental station ine zvirongwa zviviri zvemitengo. Chirongwa A chine base fare ye 1000원 uye chinowedzera 150원 paminetsi imwe neimwe, uye chirongwa B chine base fare ye 400원 uye chinowedzera 200원 paminetsi imwe neimwe. Nguva yekutasva inoverengwa mumayuniti eminetsi 1, uye unogona kutasva maminetsi 60 pakanyanya panguva imwe. Ngatitii nguva yekutasva i x maminetsi uye mutengo i y원. Ndichakupa data rimwe pachimwe.
y-m-24-02.thinking.0: Kuita kutonga kwenguva pfupi kubva padata rechikamu
y-m-24-02.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuvimba kwako mukutonga nedata itsva
y-m-24-02.prereq.0: Kuisa nhamba mumutemo wakanyorwa se linear expression kuwana mutengo
y-m-24-02.prereq.1: Kunzwisisa kuti letter x inomirira huwandu mumamiriro, sa 'nguva yekutasva (maminetsi)'
y-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa data rimwe pachimwe uye utonge kuti chirongwa chipi chakachipa. Hazvina basa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pa data rimwe nerimwe, verenga uye unyore musiyano pakati pe A ne B, uye utarise kuti musiyano uyu unochinja sei sezvo data richichinja.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukasangana neseru isingaenderane nekutonga kwako, pachinzvimbo chekuchinja kutonga kwako, funga kuti mamiriro api aizoita kuti iite.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ichi i chikamu chetebhura remitengo. Kana ukatasva maminetsi 0 (uchibhadhara base fare chete), A i 1000원 uye B i 400원. Kana ukatasva maminetsi 10, A i 2500원 uye B i 2400원.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kana wangotarisa mitsetse miviri iyi chete, ungati chirongwa chipi chakachipa kana ukatasva nguva refu?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvakanaka kufungidzira kubva pachimiro kuti musiyano uri kudzikira, sa c, uye zvakanakawo kunonotsa kutonga, sa d. Asi 'B inoramba yakachipa' haienderani nechokwadi chekuti musiyano uri kudzikira.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kunyange kana ukatasva nguva refu, B inoramba yakachipa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakangotarisa chokwadi chekuti B yaiva yakachipa mumaseru maviri. Hauna kutarisa chokwadi chekuti musiyano pakati pemitengo miviri wakachinja kubva ku 600원 kusvika ku 100원.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Painonyanya kureba kutasva, A inoramba yakachipa kupfuura B
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakataura chakapesana kunyange tebhura ichiratidza maseru apo B yakachipa. Unogona kuwana chikonzero mutebhura here?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: B yakachipa ikozvino, asi kana ukatasva nguva refu, A inogona kuva yakachipa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaverenga chimiro chekuti musiyano pakati pemitengo miviri unodzikira uye wakafungidzira zvakangwarira kuchinja kwemberi.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Pane maseru maviri chete, saka hatigone kutaura kuti ipi yakachipa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku i kutonga kunongwarira kunobvuma kuti data i shoma. Unogona kushandisabe kuchinja kwemusiyano kwaunogona kuona.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Mutengo mutsva wabuda wemaminetsi 20. A i 4000원 uye B i 4400원.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: B i yakachipa pamaminetsi 0 ne 10 uye A i yakachipa pamaminetsi 20, saka zvinoenderana nedata kutaura kuti kuchinja kunoitika pakati pemaminetsi 10 ne 20. Kana kutonga kwako kwekutanga kwaiva 'B inoramba yakachipa kwenguva shoma yakareba', chikamu ichocho chichiri kuenderera.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chengeta kutonga kwekuti B inogara iri yakachipa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Unosiya kutonga kwekutanga sezvakaita kunyange kusingaenderani nedata itsva. Kutonga uku hakugone kutsanangura mutengo pamaminetsi 20.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kumwe pakati pemaminetsi 10 ne 20, iri yakachipa inochinja
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaverenga kuti kurongeka kwehukuru hwembiri kwakadzoka uye wakafungidzira interval apo inochinja.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatonga nekutarisa seru imwe chete pamaminetsi 20. B yaiva yakachipa pamaminetsi 0 ne 10.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Data remaminetsi 20 rinoratidzika kunge rakanyorwa zvisizvo, saka chengeta kutonga kwekusvika ikozvino
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kusahadzika data pacharo kunodiwa, asi hauna hwaro hwekusahadzika. Unogona kutarisa ne expression kana mutengo wemaminetsi 20 wakarurama.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Mitemo yemitengo yakanyorwa se expressions pabhodhi renotice rechitoro. A: y=1000+150x, B: y=400+200x. Vanoti vashandisi vazhinji veiyi station vanotasva pakati pemaminetsi 8 ne 15.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvaizova zvakanaka here kuraira vanhu vanotasva maminetsi 8 kusvika 15?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamaminetsi 12 ese A ne B i 2800원. B i yakachipa kana i shoma kupfuura maminetsi 12 uye A i yakachipa kana i yakawanda. Kana vashandisi vanotasva maminetsi 8 kusvika 15, mativi ese maviri emaminetsi 12 anosanganisirwa, saka zvakaoma kuraira nzira imwe chete.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Raira zvichibva pamaminetsi 12. Kune shoma kupfuura iyoyo B i yakachipa, uye kune yakawanda A i yakachipa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Iyi i pfungwa yekuisa mitengo mu expressions kuwana nguva apo mitengo miviri inova yakaenzana uye kupatsanura zano pamberi nemushure mayo.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Base fare yaB i 600 won yakachipa, saka rayira B kune wese anotasva maminetsi 8 kusvika 15
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatonga nebase fare chete. Wakasiya kuti musiyano wemutengo paminetsi unoungana sezvo nguva ichikura.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Pamaminetsi 20 A yaiva 400 won yakachipa, saka rayira A kune wese anotasva maminetsi 8 kusvika 15
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakashandisa mhedzisiro yemaminetsi 20 sezvayakaita kumaminetsi 8 kusvika 15. Hauna kutarisa kwainochinjira.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Hapana nguva apo zvirongwa zvembiri zvinova zvakaenzana, saka raira kuti mutengo i mumwechete chero chipi chasarudzwa
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakapedza usina kuverenga kana pane nguva apo dzakaenzana. Unogona kuwana nguva apo dzakaenzana nekuisa mitengo mu expressions.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, nedata remaseru maviri unogona kungotaura kuti 'musiyano uri kudzikira'. Data painowedzera, wakadzidza kuti pane poinzi apo inochinja, uye mushure mekunge ma expressions apiwa wakagona kutaura poinzi iyoyo nenhamba. Taura kuti data ripi rakachinja kutonga kwako uye sei.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise nguva 3 dzakasiyana dzekutasva x (maminetsi) apo chirongwa A chakachipa kupfuura chirongwa B. (x i natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 60)
y-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa kukosha kwakati wandei kwa x uye unyore mari ye A nemari ye B padivi pedzimwe.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera kukosha uye utarise kana A ingava inodhura zvishoma wobva B yodhura zvishoma zvakare.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Iri kubva pamaminiti 1 kusvika pamaminiti 60 nezvikamu zveminiti 1.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita x ive nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 60 (nezvikamu zveminiti 1).
y-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Mari ye A inodhura zvishoma pane mari ye B.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Panguva ino mari ye A haidhuri zvishoma pane mari ye B. Verenga mari mbiri idzi zvakasiyana uye uenzanise.
y-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Pamaminiti 13 A ndi 2950원 uye B ndi 3000원. Pamaminiti 30 A ndi 5500원 uye B ndi 6400원. Kubva pamaminiti 13 kusvika pa 60 A inogara ichidhura zvishoma, pamaminiti 12 dzakaenzana, uye pasi pamaminiti 12 B inodhura zvishoma.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mitsara 1 kana 2 yechiziviso chechiteshi. Taura kuti hurongwa hupi hwakanaka kuvanhu vanokwira maminiti 8 kusvika 15, uchiisa nguva inoparadzanisa senhamba.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga watsvaga uye unyore nguva apo mari mbiri dzinova dzakaenzana, wobva wanyora mutsetse mumwe nomumwe wokuti ndeipi inodhura zvishoma pamberi napashure payo.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.hint.1: Isa maminiti 8 nemaminiti 15, enzanisa mari mbiri, uye utarise kana mutsara wako wakarurama.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here zvakananga nokuisa kukosha muzvirevo kuti nguva inoparadzanisa ndi maminiti 12?
y-m-24-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora here zvakaparadzaniswa nenguva pane kurudzira hurongwa humwe chete?
y-m-24-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukakwira pasi pamaminiti 12, hurongwa B hunodhura zvishoma, uye kana ukakwira kupfuura maminiti 12, hurongwa A hunodhura zvishoma. Pamaminiti 12 chaiwo dzose ndi 2800원, dzakafanana.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.model.1: Kuvanhu vanokwira maminiti 8 kusvika 11, B inodhura zvishoma, uye kuvanhu vanokwira maminiti 13 kusvika 15, A inodhura zvishoma. Pamaminiti 12 dzakaenzana, saka chero ipi inogona. Kana usingazivi kuti uchakwira kwenguva yakareba sei, musiyano mudiki padhuze nemaminiti 12, saka B, ine mari yokutanga inodhura zvishoma, haisi mutoro.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kusarudza nechikonzero chokuti musiyano mudiki kunogoneka zvakare.
y-m-24-02.s.s3.model.2: Pamberi pamaminiti 12 hurongwa B hunodhura zvishoma, uye mushure mamaminiti 12 hurongwa A hunodhura zvishoma.

y-m-24-05.title: Kana uchiziva poinzi imwe chete, basa romutsetse rinosarudzwa here?
y-m-24-05.topic: Chirevo negirafu yebasa romutsetse: kugadzira zvirevo zvinosangana nemamiriro
y-m-24-05.goal: Nzwisisa nokugadzira zvirevo iwe pachako kuti kana mamiriro asina kukwana pangava nezvirevo zvakati wandei zvinogoneka, kuti zvinova zvishoma kana mamiriro achiwedzerwa, uye kuti mamwe mamiriro haagoneki.
y-m-24-05.material: Girafu yebasa romutsetse y=ax+b (a inhamba isiri zero) mutsetse wakananga. Jimin akati, "Kana uchiziva chete kuti girafu inopfuura papoinzi (2, 5), chirevo chebasa romutsetse iri chinosarudzwa kuva chimwe chete!" (Kuverenga: poinzi (2, 5) ndiyo poinzi apo y iri 5 kana x iri 2. X-intercept ndiyo x-coordinate yepoinzi apo girafu inosangana neaxis ye x.)
y-m-24-05.thinking.1: Kugadzira zvirevo zvakati wandei zvinosangana nemamiriro
y-m-24-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva a ne b mubasa romutsetse y=ax+b pachimiro chegirafu (nhanho yeyuniti yebasa romutsetse regiredhi 8)
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kuna a=1, b=3, isa x=2 muchirevo uye utarise kana inopfuura papoinzi (2, 5).
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja a kuva dzimwe nhamba, gadzirisa b kuti ienderane, uye uverenge kuti zvirevo zvingani zvinopfuura papoinzi zvinobuda.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.a: Chinosarudzwa. Kubva pamacoordinate epoinzi imwe unogona kutsvaga a ne b zvose
y-m-24-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti poinzi imwe inokuita kuti uzive kukosha kwa a ne b zvose. Hauna kutarisa kuti nhamba mbiri dzemacoordinate epoinzi dzine hukama hupi na a ne b muchirevo.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.b: Hachisarudzwi. Hapana basa romutsetse rinopfuura papoinzi (2, 5) chose
y-m-24-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti hapana basa romutsetse rinopfuura papoinzi chose. Unogona kuziva nokuisa a ne b mashoma iwe pachako uye utarise kana dzichipfuura papoinzi.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.c: Chinosarudzwa. Macoordinate epoinzi inhamba dzizere, saka a ne b dzinhamba dzizerewo uye pane imwe chete
y-m-24-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kupoinzi ine macoordinate enhamba dzizere, a ne b dzinhamba dzizerewo. Kunyange macoordinate ari nhamba dzizere, a ne b hadzifaniri kuva nhamba dzizere.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.d: Hachisarudzwi. Pane mapeya akati wandei e a ne b anopfuura papoinzi
y-m-24-05.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakatarisa hukama pakati pa a ne b uye kwakaverenga kuti pane mapeya akati wandei.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.explain: Kuti upfuure papoinzi (2, 5), chirevo chinofanira kushanda kana x=2 ne y=5 dzaiswa, saka hukama humwe chete hunoonekwa pakati pa a ne b. a ne b nhamba mbiri asi pane hukama humwe, saka pane mapeya akati wandei. Semuenzaniso, (a, b)=(1, 3), (-1, 7), (5, -5) dzose dzinopfuura papoinzi (2, 5).
y-m-24-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mabasa 3 akasiyana omutsetse y=ax+b anopfuura papoinzi (2, 5) uye ane x-intercept iri nhamba yakazara iri pamusoro. Isa nhamba dzakakodzera dza a ne b. (Unogona kunyora chete nhamba dzinogona kunyorwa sedhesimali.)
y-m-24-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kana x-intercept yakagadziriswa, girafu inopfuura papoinzi mbiri, (x-intercept, 0) ne (2, 5). Gadzirisa x-intercept imwe.
y-m-24-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana mapoinzi maviri agadzirwa, tsvaga a ne b, uye utarise nokuisa x=2 kana poinzi (2, 5) ichipa 5.
y-m-24-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Kuti ive basa romutsetse, a haifaniri kuva 0.
y-m-24-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana x=2 yaiswa, y haiite 5, saka haipfuuri papoinzi (2, 5).
y-m-24-05.s.s2.fail.c3: X-intercept (x kana y iri 0) haisi nhamba yakazara iri pamusoro. Isa y=0 uye utsvage x.

y-m-24-04.title: Mhinduro yehuwandu hwezvinwiwa: yakatanga kukanganisa papi?

y-m-24-04.goal: Mumhinduro yedambudziko rokusaenzana, tsvaga mutsetse unopikisa chirevo chomutsara, uye utsanangure nokutarisa nenhamba kuti mhinduro inochinja sei kana mashoko emamiriro achichinja.

Kuverenga: 900x ndi 'mazana mapfumbamwe x', '<' inoreva shoma pa, '≤' inoreva shoma pa kana kuenzana.)

y-m-24-04.s.s2.r.c: Iyi ipfungwa yakaziva kuti kuti shoko rinosanganisira 'kuenzana' kunogona kuparadzanisa mhinduro.
y-m-24-04.s.s2.explain: Nemabhodhoro 10, 900×10+3000=12000원, saka inobvumirwa pasi pe 'kana kushoma'. Nemabhodhoro 11 ndi 12900원, iri pamusoro pe 12000원. Saka ne 'kana kushoma' ndi mabhodhoro 10 zvakanyanya, uye ne 'shoma pa' ndi mabhodhoro 9 zvakanyanya.

y-m-24-03.title: Zvirevo zvakaenzana zvehama nhatu: ndechipi chinoenderana nedambudziko iri?

y-m-24-03.goal: Nzwisisa kuti pangava nezvirevo zvakaenzana zvakati wandei zvinotsanangura mamiriro akafanana, uye utarise kana zvikamu nezvinoreva mavara zvichienderana, kuti usarudze chirevo chisinganyatsowirirana pasina kuchigadzirisa.

(Kuverenga: 3x ndi 'tatu x', 3000x ndi 'zviuru zvitatu x'.) Shamwari nhatu dzakanyora mamiriro aya sezvirevo zvakaenzana. 가: x+y=10 uye 3000x+2000y=24000. 나: x+y=10 uye 3x+2y=24000. 다: x+y=10 uye 3x+2y=24. Uye pane shamwari inyewo yakanyora 라: x+y=10 uye 2000x+3000y=24000.

y-m-24-06.prereq.1: Chirevo chekuwanda nechenhamba dzakaenzana nedzisina kuenzana
y-m-24-06.s.s1.prompt: Yedza chirevo chaJiyun pamwe chete nedata itsva.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pachidimbu chega chega chedata, maka kana nhamba iri musquare yepamusoro kuruboshwe i even kana odd.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kana data rikabuda risingaenderani nekutonga kwako, verenga kamwe zvakare kuongorora, wobva wasarudza kuti ugadzirise sei kutonga kwako.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Jiyun akaedza katatu. Kana square yepamusoro kuruboshwe iri yechi2, wedzera 2, 3, 9, 10 kuwana 24. Kana iri yechi10, wedzera 10, 11, 17, 18 kuwana 56. Kana iri yechi12, wedzera 12, 13, 19, 20 kuwana 64. Katatu kose imultiple ye8.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo chaJiyun ('inogara iri multiple ye8')?
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Mienzaniso mitatu inotsigira mutemo, asi hapana vimbiso yekuti mutemo wakafanana unoshanda pachinzvimbo chese. Zvakakodzerawo kucherekedza kuti masquare epamusoro kuruboshwe aiva 2, 10, ne12 (ose even).
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yakarurama katatu kose, saka tinogona kuvimba kuti inogara ichishanda
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakashandura kuongorora katatu kuita 'nguva dzose'. Hauna kutarisa kuti nzvimbo dzakaedzwa dzaiva dzerudzi rupi.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoita sezvakarurama, asi nzvimbo nhatu chete dzakaedzwa, saka kwakamira kuva nechokwadi
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaziva kuti mienzaniso inotsigira mutemo asi haisi humbowo.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Huwandu hwose hwakasiyana, 24, 56, 64, saka haisi mutemo asi mukana
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakasarudza kuti haisi mutemo nokuti kukosha kwehuwandu kwakasiyana. Kunyange kukosha kwakasiyana, kune chinhu chavanogoverana: zvose imultiple ye8.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Handisati ndagona kutonga, saka ndinoda kuedzawo dzimwe nzvimbo
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kutonga kunoona mienzaniso seyakashomeka uye kunoedza kuwana data idzva.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Minseo akaedza dzimwe nzvimbo. Kana square yepamusoro kuruboshwe iri yechi1, wedzera 1, 2, 8, 9 kuwana 20. Kana iri yechi3, wedzera 3, 4, 10, 11 kuwana 28.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Chii chinofanira kuitwa nechirevo chaJiyun zvino?
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.after: 20 ne28 hadzisi mamultiple e8, saka 'nguva dzose' yaputswa. Asi yakanga yakarurama kumasquare even, saka nzira mbiri dzose, kurasa mutemo kana kuugadzirisa nekuwedzera mamiriro, dzinonzwisisika.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 20 ne28 hadzisi mamultiple e8, saka 'inogara iri multiple ye8' haishande
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaziva simba recounterexample: kana kunyange muenzaniso mumwe uchiputsa mutemo, 'nguva dzose' haishande.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 20 ne28 dzingangove dzakaverengwa zvisirizvo, saka siya chirevo chaJiyun sezvachakaita
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakapa mhosva kudata idzva sekukanganisa kuverenga. Unogona kuongorora zvakare nyore nekuwedzera nhamba ina mumabhuroko ose maviri.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kana ukawedzera mamiriro e 'kana square yepamusoro kuruboshwe iri even chete', chirevo chaJiyun chinogona kuponeswa
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekusarasa mutemo asi kuugadzirisa nekupfupisa chiyero umo unoshanda.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kune mbiri chete, saka chirevo chaJiyun hachigoni kurasirwa zvino
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Counterexample imwe chete inoputsa 'nguva dzose', asi wakachisundira shure nokuti dzishoma.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana nhamba iri musquare yepamusoro kuruboshwe i a, nhamba ina dzi a, a+1, a+7, a+8, uye huwandu i4a+16.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.after: 4a+16=4(a+4), saka inogara iri multiple ye4. Inova multiple ye8 chete kana a+4 iri even, ndiko kuti, chete kana a iri even. Chirevo chaJiyun chakarurama kana ukawedzera mamiriro e 'kana square yepamusoro kuruboshwe iri even'.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Chero a ichiva chii, huwandu imultiple ye8. Chirevo chaJiyun chasimbiswa nemavara
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakati imultiple ye8 uchitarisa pamusoro chete pekutaura. Hazvienderani nechokwadi chekuti huwandu 20, husiri multiple ye8, hwakabuda kare.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Huwandu i4a+16, saka a kana ichikura, inova padhuze nemultiple ye8
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakasanganisa a kukura nekuti imultiple here. Kuva multiple hakusarudzwi nehukuru asi nekuti inogovanisa zvakaenzana here.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Chero a ichiva chii, huwandu imultiple ye4, uye kana iri multiple ye8 zvinoenderana ne a
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaverenga kutaura se4×(a+4) ukukubatanidza nedata rekutanga (nyaya dzeven chete ndidzo mamultiple e8).
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kutaura kuna a, saka hatigoni kuziva kuti imultiple yei
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti hapana chinogona kutaurwa kana pane tsamba. Kana ukaita factor kutaura, unogona kuona factor inogara iripo.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.reflect: Nemienzaniso mitatu waigona kutaura chete kuti 'zvinoita sezvakarurama'. Kana counterexample yabuda, 'nguva dzose' yaputswa, uye nekutaura kwemavara waigona kuona mamiriro apo kunoshanda. Taura kuti kutonga kwako kwakachinja panhanho ipi.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.prompt: Pakarenda imwe chete, wana uye uise nhamba 3 dzakasiyana a dzesquare yepamusoro kuruboshwe dzakadai kuti huwandu hwenhamba ina dziri mubhuroko re2×2 imultiple ye12. (a inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa23, uye square yeMugovera sa7, 14, kana 21 haigoni kuva yepamusoro kuruboshwe.)
y-m-24-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzika a imwe uye uwedzere nhamba ina a, a+1, a+7, a+8 iwe amene kuona kana huwandu imultiple ye12.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.hint.1: Uchishandisa kutaura kwehuwandu kwawakawana kare, tarisa kutaura uye ushande kuti a inofanira kusarudzwa sei kuti ive multiple ye12.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Inhamba inogadzira bhuroko re2×2 mukati merenda.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa23.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Multiple ye7 isquare yeMugovera, saka square iri kurudyi kwayo inopfuudzira kumutsara unotevera. Haigoni kuva yepamusoro kuruboshwe.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwenhamba ina hauzi multiple ye12. Wedzera nhamba ina iwe amene.
y-m-24-06.s.s2.explain: Huwandu i4a+16=4(a+4), saka kana a+4 iri multiple ye3, huwandu imultiple ye12. Nhamba a dzinokodzera i2, 5, 8, 11, 17, 20, 23. 14 inewo a+4=18, multiple ye3, asi isquare yeMugovera saka haigoni kushandiswa.
